text: Pellet [ko non woniri], ɗum yonay on. No woodani on wewlere Ballal Alla goo : si on muññike e hare nden, on hulii Alla, on ɓeydiraama woɗɓe goo ardooɓe yaccaare ko wallitoo on e ayɓe ɓen; ɗum fow si waɗii, haray Joomi mon Walliray on guluuje jowi Malaa'ika maandiraaɓe e mun kañum e pucci mun; maandeeji feeñuɗi.
